lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Dolla.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I'd say you and I are good friends, right?
What's this all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Why are you talking like that?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Do you need money or something?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: That hurts, you know :(

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: We have been squadmates for a while now.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: And you've helped me on so many different occasions.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Get to the point.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: And before you say it, I suggest you think carefully.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Geez!

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: You don't have to be so mean about it.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I heard that you're going to take over a tableware company.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: How about letting me take it over?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: After all, you've got fingers in every pie, not just tableware.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Give me one good reason why I should let you in on this.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: Yikes,

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: things got real tense, real quick in here.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: Wonder who's gonna come out on top?
Stop adding fuel to the fire.
How exciting!

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: All right then. First off...

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Do you remember that thingamajig your company wanted to develop before?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Let me run the tableware company,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: and we can cooperate on every single R&D project this year, including that one.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: I'll also do everything in my power to help out

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: with that new generation of biotablets you'll be launching soon.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Promotional events, expo booths, you name it.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Would you put up promos in all your chain stores?

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Of course! ;)

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: What did you think I'd do, just hold the event in one store?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: If I hadn't asked, I'm sure you'd have done just that.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Will Missilis's products hit the market at the same time as our tablet?

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: This is getting good!
Ohhh!
Hmm...

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Do we have a deal?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I have one more condition.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Name it...

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I'll be in charge of the shipping and handling

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: for all our clients in the future.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Oh, come on!

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Don't push your luck, little girl.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: Hey, wait a sec!!

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: You're telling me that all of us invested,

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: but the supplies were actually being delivered by Yan the entire time?! :O

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: I've always wanted to be in charge of shipping.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Ladies,

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: let's be rational, okay?

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: That's rich,

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: coming from someone who was trying to edge us out

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: and gain a monopoly from the very beginning.
Calm down, everyone.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Shut up, you fool.

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: This has nothing to do with you.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: Don't worry Sweetie, this isn't your fight!

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: Let's discuss this somewhere else

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: where we won't be disturbed.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: Okay! ☆

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Good grief.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: You're driving me crazy.
Why don't you take turns handling shipping?
There's no reply from anyone...
